name: parallel-test-jobs-cap-plan-a
title: Story #6 (OSS-launch fix-wave): cap test:all default --jobs to fix parallel-race convergence-tail (Plan A)
description: Change root package.json test:all to invoke the runner with --jobs N where N is empirically measured (start N=4; fall back to N=2 if needed) so workers do not oversubscribe contended kernel resources (git index lock, fs syncfs, /tmp IO). Expected to resolve the convergence-tail of parallel-race timeouts that B-24c3 couldn't solve via per-smoke timeoutMs bumps alone. Tests/config-only — 0 production change, 0 smoke logic change, 0 manifest change, 0 runner change. Out of scope: Plan B (two-pass retry) is a separate follow-up story if Plan A insufficient.
